children: Sweden technology group's Q3 net sales rose 22% yr/yr, with broad-based growth
Q3 EBITA margin strengthened to 14.3% from 12.2%
Company attributes results to higher volumes, gross margins, and cost restraint
Ependion says geopolitical uncertainty expected to persist, with potential short-term effects on business
Company remains focused on profitable growth through investments in technology and new markets
Ependion confident about remainder of 2026 and ability to deliver profitable growth for full year
ENERGY SEGMENT - Co said Westermo's order intake was driven by strong development in the energy segment across several markets and product areas
MARINE AND MANUFACTURING DEMAND - Co said Beijer Electronics' order intake rose due to increased demand in the marine segment and manufacturing industry
COMPONENT MARKET STRAINS - Co said inventory levels were adversely affected by strained component market and uncertainty about future developments
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the integrated hardware & software peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Ependion AB is SEK170.00, about 9.8% above its October 22 closing price of SEK154.80
The stock recently traded at 19 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 22 three months ago
